name: VNAO T-45C Goshawk
summary: Free carrier-capable T-45C Goshawk naval jet trainer mod by Virtual Naval Air Operations.
description: Flyable US Navy T-45C trainer with carrier operations. Download link (MediaFire) is in the official ED forum thread; a livery paint kit is on ED User Files.

releases.changelog: SRS script removed from the package since T-45 support is now in SRS.
